info.title: Route_Resolution
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Resolution](#/Route_Resolution)
Destination IP address to be resolved. If exact prefix match is requested, then the agent needs to specify the address and mask in address/mask format.

coalescence_id.description: Hash value calculated based on Origin, VRF, Address, and  L2 Details, which are processed as tuples of Nexthop, MAC Address  and Port

exact_prefix_match.description: Specifies whether exact prefix match is requested by the agent.

interfaces.description:
Reference Resource: [Interface](#/Interface)
List of interfaces for which individual ECMP groups are required. Generally used for tunneling: tunnels that share same destinations, would have different source addresses and would thus require separate ECMP groups.

l2_resolution_required.description: Specifies whether L2 resolution down to port, MAC, VLAN is required.

origin.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Resolution](#/Route_Resolution)
Agent in the system that requires address to be resolved.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Resolution](#/Route_Resolution)
Specifies the L3 interface of the address for which resolution is requested. This is only required if the resolution request is for an IPv6 link-local address.

distance.description: Administrative distance for the route entry.

from.description: Source of this route: 'connected':  subnet is directly connected to the switch 'static':     route is configured manually on the switch 'bgp':        sourced from BGP protocol 'ospf':       sourced from OSPF protocol 'local':      it's an IP address configured on the switch itself

metric.description: Metric associated with this route entry.

prefix.description: IPv4 or IPv6 destination prefix and mask in the address/mask format. Example 192.168.0.0/16

type.description: Specifies if the route is of type nullroute, reject, forward or local: 'forward':    the packets that match the route for destination will be forwarded               based on the nexthop entry. 'reject':     the packets that match the route for destination will be discarded               and an ICMP unreachable message is sent to the sender. 'nullroute':  the packets that match the route for destination will be silently               discarded without sending any ICMP message to the sender. 'local':      the packets that match the route for destination will be consumed by               the device and will not be forwarded.

route_nexthops.description:
Reference Resource: [Nexthop](#/Nexthop)
List of all the nexthops for this entry. This will be empty in case of nullroute/reject.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
